author: SickProdigy
description: Post cached Rocket League schedules from BLAST and configured start.gg or Challonge tournaments.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild announcement channel settings, cached public tournament information, and identifiers for schedule updates already delivered. It does not store member data.
install_msg: Use `[p]rlcsset channel #channel` for cached RLCS updates. Configure start.gg tokens or Challonge OAuth client credentials before adding provider tournament URLs with `[p]rocketleagueset tournamentadd <url>`.
name: RocketLeague
short: Cached RLCS schedules and guild announcements
